content: To all those who dwell in the worlds of the ten directions,The lions among men, the Tathāgatas of the three times,To every one of them without exception,I pay homage with devotion of body, speech, and mind.By the power of this prayer for excellent conduct,With all the Victors appearing vividly before my mind,Bowing with bodies as numerous as the atoms of the realms,I prostrate deeply to all the Victors.Upon a single atom are Buddhas as numerous as all atoms,Each sitting in the midst of their Bodhisattva heirs;In this way, I imagine the entire expanse of the realm of phenomena,To be completely filled with Victorious Ones.With oceans of inexhaustible praise for them,And through the sounds of oceans of melodic factors,I express the infinite qualities of all the Victors,And I praise all those who have gone to bliss.With the finest flowers and the finest garlands,With cymbals, scented ointments, and supreme parasols,With supreme lamps and the finest incense,I make offerings to those Victorious Ones.With the finest garments and supreme fragrances,With mounds of powdered incense as high as Mount Meru,And with every kind of outstanding and sublime array,I make offerings to those Victorious Ones.With offerings that are unsurpassed and vast,I direct my devotion toward all the Victors;Through the power of faith in the Conduct of Excellence,I prostrate and make offerings to all the Victors.Driven by the power of desire, hatred, and ignorance,Through body, speech, and likewise through the mind,Whatever negative actions I have committed,All of these I individually confess.In the merit of all the Victors of the ten directions and the Bodhisattvas,The Pratyekabuddhas, those in training and those beyond training,And in the merit of every living being,In all of that, I rejoice.Those who are the lamps of the worlds in the ten directions,Who have attained the non-attachment of Buddhahood through the stages of enlightenment,To all those Protectors, I make this request:I exhort you to turn the unsurpassed wheel of Dharma.To those who intend to demonstrate their passing into nirvana,For the sake of the benefit and happiness of all wandering beings,I pray with palms joined together,That they remain for as many eons as there are atoms in the realms.Through prostrating, making offerings, and confessing,Rejoicing, exhorting, and beseeching,Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated,I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.
